title: challenge and user.id passed as Uint8Array views with a non-zero byteOffset

unsafe.definition: a stored passkey whose user.id is the whole 64-byte buffer instead of the 16-byte view, so the page/RP never got the passkey it asked for

note: WebIDL "get a copy of the bytes held by the buffer source" honours byteOffset/byteLength; the RP checks the 32-byte challenge and userHandle, so a provider copying view.buffer fails.
